title: The role setting "View mode: Tech view" still works as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role made for this test, role A, with "View mode: Tech view" set in Roles & Permissions, so staff member A gets the simplified interface.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on role A, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only, who can sign in.
custom_steps:
1. Sign out.
  2. Sign in as staff member A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • You are signed out.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A sees the simplified Tech view interface, as before, although their Technician toggle is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • Terminology: “Tech View → the Work Orders display with one group per technician. The role setting "View mode: Tech view" in Roles & Permissions, a simplified interface, is a different thing and does not change.”
